caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) metric during fine-tuning of a Whisper model, comparing several configurations across training epochs. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels displayed at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and displays a linear scale ranging from approximately 28 to 70. A dark gray solid line with circle markers, labeled "tiny AdaLoRA_int8", starts at approximately 65.8 at epoch 0, declines to a value of approximately 42.2 at epoch 2, and then appears to plateau around 39.4 at epoch 6. A light gray dashed line with circle markers labeled "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" begins at approximately 63.3 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately 47.6 at epoch 2, and levels off around 38.9 at epoch 6. A light gray dotted line with triangle markers, labeled "tiny int8", starts at approximately 32.6 at epoch 0, declines to around 29.2 at epoch 2, and stabilizes at approximately 33.1 at epoch 6. A dark gray dashed line with triangle markers, labeled "tiny int4", initiates at approximately 28.7 at epoch 0, falls to approximately 25.9 at epoch 2, and finally reaches a value of approximately 30.7 at epoch 6. A light gray dashed line with star markers, labeled "tiny full," begins at approximately 33.4 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 28.5 at epoch 6.
